# Function for converting.
```{r}
convert_to_10x = function(obj, samples) { 
  for (i in 1:length(samples)) {
    print(paste0("Converting sample ", samples[i]))
    obj_sub = obj[[samples[i]]]
    DropletUtils::write10xCounts(path = paste0(getwd(), "/input_data/metacells_files/", samples[i]), x = obj_sub[["RNA"]]@data, type = "sparse", version = "3")
  }
}
```


# Prep for metacells.
```{r}
# Load data.
annotated_11994_seu = readRDS("rds_objects/5_annotated_11994_monocytes.rds")
annotated_11994_seu$sample_cell_type = paste(annotated_11994_seu$Sample_ID, annotated_11994_seu$Cell_Type, sep = "_")

# Split data.
annotated_11994.list = Seurat::SplitObject(annotated_11994_seu, split.by = "sample_cell_type")
sample_names = unique(annotated_11994_seu$sample_cell_type)
sample_names = sample_names[grep("monocytes", sample_names)]

# Convert.
convert_to_10x(obj = annotated_11994.list, samples = sample_names)
```
